name: Pills and claims scatter behind a skeptical headline
looks: A chaotic burst of small pill, capsule and star icons scatters outward across a dark field, overlapping and drifting at different speeds, while a skeptical headline ("Everyone swears it works.") sits centred and still against the noise.
build: Each icon is an independent sprite with its own seeded start velocity and slow rotation, spawned in a burst (`t=0`) and drifting outward with light drag so the field thins over the shot rather than looping. The headline stays perfectly static, a deliberate anchor against the motion around it.
sound: A low, slightly dissonant rattle under the scatter, nothing rhythmic, so it reads as noise rather than music.
prompt: Scatter a burst of small icons representing competing, unreliable claims outward across a dark field, each drifting at its own speed and angle, while a single skeptical headline sits perfectly still at the centre as the one fixed point against the noise.
